title: Balluff visual asset brief
description: Structured brief the prompt builder compiles into a GLM build prompt or a GPT-Image-2 generation prompt. Validates against brand.spec.json conventions. One brief = one asset need.

asset_type.description: Drives the default route per brand.spec.json.generation.routing.

audience.default: technically-literate automation engineers, plant managers, OEM design teams, procurement

message.description: Single-sentence claim; number-led, no superlatives (brand.spec voice.forbidden_words).

route.description: code routes -> GLM build; image_generation/edit -> GPT-Image-2; hybrid -> generated source + code overlay.

safe_area.description: region to leave open for code-overlaid headline/logo

style.default: silver-gray Balluff Room register; engineered, clean, technical; premium B2B; restrained

composition.default: dynamic 45deg, never centered; asymmetric; generous negative space

lighting.default: soft directional; product glow rim-light; clean drop shadow

palette.default: achromatic (#1d1d1b / #ffffff / gray ramp) + Balluff Red #e73446 as condiment only

reference_images.description: Absolute/relative paths to attach (REQUIRED when asset needs the Balluff Room backdrop: ./balluff-rooms/balluff-room-studio-01.jpg). Reference priming is the #1 brand-locking lever — see brand-locking.md.

in_image_text.description: Prefer false — GPT-Image-2 text rendering drifts. Overlay real text in code.

exact_text.description: if in_image_text true, the exact quoted copy

brand_locking.description: Deterministic post-generation steps (brand-locking.md). Applied after raster generation.

palette_snap.description: quantize toward the locked achromatic palette

code_overlay_logo.description: composite the real wordmark SVG, never let the model draw it

provenance.description: Filled by the harness on generation (manifest pattern).
